name: model/forge
description: Start a model forge job — sends forge parameters to a grid node with GPU for training. Returns job ID for status tracking.

params.name: pruneLevel
params.description: Pruning level 0.0-0.7 (fraction of heads to prune)

params.name: experts
params.description: Number of MoE experts to keep (0 for non-MoE models)

params.name: nodeId
params.description: Target grid node. If omitted, routes to first available GPU node.

results.name: jobId
results.description: Unique forge job ID for status tracking

results.name: nodeId
results.description: Grid node the job was routed to

results.name: estimatedDuration
results.description: Estimated duration based on model size and steps

examples.description: Start a code forge on Qwen3.5-4B
